# Test fixtures

## nflverse_2026_snapshot_2026-10-03.csv

Real NFL schedule snapshot, 2026 season rows only, downloaded 2026-10-03 from
nflverse `games.csv` (https://github.com/nflverse/nfldata, `data/games.csv`).
Data credit: the nflverse project and its contributors. Used unmodified as a
recorded fixture for tests; the upstream repository states no license.

Any modified versions used in tests are created in test code and labeled
"HAND-EDITED" there; this file is never edited.
